buffs.name: Perfect Flash
buffs.condition: caster HP >95%; near target (falls to +10% far away); 25 Intelligence

buffs.name: Strengthening Potion 3 Plumfruit 2 Browncap
buffs.condition: brewed at 100 Intelligence with Apothecary (by crafter), consumed within 15 sec effect
buffs.provenance: Recipe arithmetic verified in Alchemy; Nov-2025 patch nerfed damage potion effect 50%, wiki ingredient figures may already reflect patch; CURRENT PVP BUFF UNVERIFIED
buffs.comment: Do not interpret 27.5% as live 2026 bonus without confirming whether wiki's +2% per ingredient reflects Nov-2025 nerf. Drinking Browncap inflicts instant self-damage and Plumfruit reduces regen; threatens Perfect Flash (>95% HP) without Biotic Salts or heal.

buffs.name: Taunt
buffs.condition: target affected; 25 Charisma; buff counted under damage modifier cap

buffs.name: Flame Within
buffs.condition: burning self (25 Flamecharm); continuous self-burn threatens >95% HP for Perfect Flash

buffs.name: Inhale
buffs.applies_to: next Galebreathe mantra OR next Flamecharm mantra with Fan the Flames
buffs.condition: Inhale Galebreathe mantra (Lv5 = 80 Galebreathe for +10%), next eligible cast within 5s; potency +2% per inhaled mantra level

buffs.name: Lose Your Mind

buffs.provenance: documented amount; cap channel assumed common pending in-game test

buffs.name: Dark Hours
